covered_actors: AI business operators (인공지능사업자), including AI development business operators (인공지능개발사업자) and AI utilizing business operators (인공지능이용사업자)
Foreign/offshore AI business operators meeting proposed revenue, user-count, or safety-incident investigation thresholds for domestic representative designation
State agencies, local governments, and public institutions (국가기관등), public corporations, government-funded research institutes, and national/public universities
Small and medium-sized enterprises, venture enterprises, and small business owners (중소기업등)

Korea AI Safety Institute (인공지능안전연구소), AI Policy Center (인공지능정책센터, including NIA), High-Impact AI Expert Committee (전문위원회), AI cluster dedicated agencies (전담기관), and Korea AI Promotion Association (한국인공지능진흥협회)

evidence.quote: 제23조(인공지능 안전성 확보 의무) ① 법 제32조제1항에서 “대통령령으로 정하는 기준 이상인 인공지능시스템”이란 학습에 사용된 누적 연산량이 10의 26승 부동소수점 연산 이상인 인공지능시스템으로서 과학기술정보통신부장관이 인공지능기술 발전 수준, 위험도 등을 고려하여 고시하는 기준에 해당하는 인공지능시스템을 말한다.
evidence.quote_en: Article 23(1): An AI system meeting or exceeding the Presidential Decree threshold under Act Art. 32(1) means an AI system whose cumulative training compute is at least 10^26 FLOPs and meets criteria notified by MSIT considering technological development and risk level.

evidence.quote:
1. 법 제12조제1항에 따른 인공지능안전(이하 “인공지능안전”이라 한다) 관련 자문 및 교육
2. 인공지능안전 관련 평가 시스템의 구축 및 운영
evidence.quote_en: 1. Advisory and education related to AI safety under Article 12(1) of the Act; 2. Establishment and operation of evaluation systems related to AI safety.

evidence.quote: 법 제32조제1항에 따른 인공지능 안전성 확보 의무의 대상이 되는 인공지능시스템은 학습에 사용된 누적 연산량이 10의 26승 부동소수점 연산 이상인 인공지능시스템으로서 인공지능기술 발전 수준, 위험도 등을 고려하여 고시하는 기준에 해당하는 인공지능시스템으로 함.
evidence.quote_en: AI systems subject to AI safety assurance obligations under Act Art. 32(1) are defined as those with cumulative training compute >= 10^26 FLOPs meeting MSIT-notified criteria considering technology advancement and risk level.

evidence.quote: 제22조(인공지능 투명성 확보 의무) ① 인공지능사업자는 고영향 인공지능이나 생성형 인공지능을 이용한 제품 또는 서비스(이하 “제품등”이라 한다)를 제공하기 전에 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 방법으로 법 제31조제1항에 따른 고지를 하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: Before providing a product or service using high-impact AI or generative AI, an AI business operator shall provide prior notice under Act Art. 31(1) through one of the enumerated methods.

evidence.quote: ② 인공지능사업자는 법 제34조제1항 각 호의 조치 중에서 다음 각 호에 해당하는 내용을 사업장 또는 인공지능사업자의 홈페이지 등에 게시하여야 한다. 다만, 「부정경쟁방지 및 영업비밀보호에 관한 법률」 제2조제2호에 따른 영업비밀에 해당하는 사항은 제외할 수 있다.

evidence.quote:

enforcement_authorities: National AI Committee (국가인공지능위원회) and 13 listed central ministries/commissions (Draft Art. 4(1))
High-Impact AI Expert Committee (고영향 인공지능 전문위원회)
AI Policy Center (인공지능정책센터 — including NIA / 한국지능정보사회진흥원)
Ministry of National Defense (국방부), National Intelligence Service (국가정보원), and National Police Agency (경찰청) — for Draft Art. 2 national-security exclusions
compliance_deadlines: 2025-11-12 to 2025-12-22: Public legislative notice (입법예고) consultation period
2026-01-22: Proposed effective date of the draft enforcement decree (Draft Addenda Art. 1)
Within 3 months of receipt: State/public agencies report improvement plans following Committee recommendations (Draft Art. 7(1))
Annually by January 31: AI Safety Institute submits annual performance and plan to MSIT (Draft Art. 10(5))
Within 30 days (extendable once by up to 30 days): MSIT reply period for high-impact AI confirmation/re-confirmation; 10-day appeal window (Draft Art. 24)
5 years: Proposed retention period for high-impact AI compliance documents (Draft Art. 26(1))
penalties_summary: Proposed Annex 2 establishes graduated administrative fines (over a 2-year repeat window): failure to provide prior AI transparency notice under Act Art. 31(1) draws KRW 5M / 10M / 15M (1st / 2nd / 3rd+ offense); failure to designate a domestic representative under Act Art. 36(1) draws KRW 20M across all offenses; failure to obey a cease or corrective order under Act Art. 40(3) draws KRW 10M / 20M / 30M. Fines may be reduced by up to 50% for SMEs/ventures/small businesses, minor carelessness, or remediation efforts, and increased by up to 50% (capped at KRW 30M) for severe harm or violations lasting 6+ months.
implementation_notes: Un-enacted MSIT legislative notice draft (입법예고, 2025-11-12 to 2025-12-22, pre-MOLEG review) of the AI Basic Act Enforcement Decree, subsequently superseded by enacted Presidential Decree No. 36053 (2026-01-21). Distinctively includes the full text of Annex 1 (sectoral compliance equivalences under Digital Medical Products Act, Nuclear Safety Act, Autonomous Vehicles/Ships Acts, Credit Information Act, Financial Consumer Protection Act, Intelligent Informatization Act, and PIPA), Annex 2 (graduated fine table with 50% SME mitigation), and Form 1 (High-Impact AI Confirmation Request requiring base/derivative model and training-data personal-info/trade-secret declarations). Notable drafting differences later revised in the enacted decree include Draft Art. 28(1)(4) (safety-incident investigation trigger for domestic representatives), Draft Art. 31 (investigation-declination clause), and 10-staff requirement for cluster dedicated agencies (reduced to 5 in the enacted decree).
